"Burnham finalising cabinet before becoming PM on Monday" — ITV News, 17 July 2026.

There has been speculation over Burnham's choice of chancellor, with allies on Labour's left favouring Ed Miliband, but reports suggesting Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood will get the crucial role.

DIRECT QUOTE — Andy Burnham: "I am finalising those decisions, and I will come to conclusions very shortly, and then I will announce those on Monday".
